judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge (`info%% x\u2028%% c\nshowInfo\n`), remove the unmarked Comment fragment at [14,22], add a source-consistent Keyword token showInfo at [14,22], change InfoDiagram.showInfo from false to true, and extend InfoDiagram.range from [0,4] to [0,22] with the corresponding location. checkTree() returns []. This violates the ordered lexical rules: the native comment continues after U+2028 and the common comment region, so showInfo does not start a new unit. The composite-splitting cases are reported in check-tree-shared-tokens.test.ts: title ("fails an info title held in one token with its keyword and value"), accessibility title ("fails an info accessibility title held in one token with its keyword colon and value"), accessibility description ("fails an info accessibility description held in one token with its keyword colon and value"), and description block ("fails an info description block held in one token with its keyword braces and value").

rows.about: Native percent-pair comments become shared Comment records with mark `%%`, from

judgment.note: In info/lex-comment-ls-bridge (`info%% x\u2028%% c\nshowInfo\n`), remove the unmarked Comment fragment at [14,22], add a source-consistent Keyword token `showInfo` at [14,22], change InfoDiagram.showInfo from false to true, and extend its range from [0,4] to [0,22] with the corresponding location. checkTree() returns []. It misses that the native percent-pair comment continues after U+2028 and the common comment region, so `showInfo` is still comment text. The other cases are reported in check-tree-shared-tokens.test.ts: the mark (`fails an info native comment with the mark hash`), its first percent (`fails an info native comment whose range leaves out its first percent`), excluded preceding padding (`fails an info native comment whose range starts at its preceding padding`), physical EOL (`fails an info native comment whose range includes its physical LF`), U+2029 not ending it (`fails an info native comment whose range ends at U+2029`), and a common region cutting it (`fails an info native comment held in one record across a common comment region`).
